statements.statement: A diode allows current to flow in both directions equally.
statements.explanation: A diode acts as a one-way valve, allowing current to flow in only one direction and blocking it in the other.

statements.statement: Diodes can be used to convert AC (alternating current) to DC (direct current).
statements.explanation: By letting only one direction of alternating current pass through, diodes can convert AC to DC.

statements.statement: Diodes can protect circuits from accidental reverse connections.
statements.explanation: Because diodes block current in one direction, they can prevent damage when a power source is accidentally connected backwards.
